items.title: Bounty scanner: a CI job that searches GitHub daily for open issues with a bounty label or `/bounty $` comment, reads amount, language, repo activity, licence and contribution rules, excludes security-testing repositories and vulnerability reports, ranks by amount × fit ÷ age, writes docs/bounties/BOARD.md and files a queue item for the top three
items.why: RESEARCH §2: 553 open labelled bounties today and no routine reads them; the GitHub API is reachable from every sandbox and the runner (GITHUB_TOKEN suffices for search). Fit = TypeScript/JavaScript/Python/Rust, tests present, a CONTRIBUTING that does not forbid AI-assisted work. Built 2026-10-11 (interactive): scripts/bounty-scanner.ts + .github/workflows/bounty-board.yml (05:17 daily); first board read 498 issues, kept 56 with an amount, filed three.
items.proof: BOARD.md refreshed daily with ranked bounties; three queue items filed from it

items.title: First bounty: take the scanner's top-ranked issue, fork, fix with tests in the project's conventions, open the PR with `/claim #<issue>` and a plain note on how it was built, then track it to merge
items.why: The posted amount is the proof of demand; a merged PR is the whole sale. Needs PR_TOKEN (action 021) to push the fork from CI and the board sign-in (action 022) so the claim resolves to the owner's account. Unblocked 2026-10-11: PR_TOKEN present and the owner signed in to the board with their GitHub account.
items.proof: PR merged and the bounty paid (revenue row in docs/LEDGER.md)
items.blocked_on: a funded bounty with no assignee and no open PR that is code with tests — none on the 2026-10-11 or 2026-10-12 boards (10-12 top three: a mobile app needing maintainer assignment and real-device recordings, a $5 user-testing task that forbids AI-run sessions, a $5 showcase-project community reward); the scanner now also drops those shapes (bounty-scanner-work-shape), so the next board that files a free funded code item unblocks this

items.title: Scanner: count a $N as funded only when a label, the bounty bot or a maintainer posted it (contributor proposals dropped), read assignees and open linked PRs, rank by competition and file only free funded issues
items.why: The first board's top three could not be built (2026-10-11 build): tt-metal#59732 was assigned with a PR submitted, turso#8749's $650 was a contributor asking, SUSU-LABS#37 had two PRs open and omi's $250 rows were the issue authors' own proposals. Built 2026-10-11 (build): fundingOf/openPrs/takenBy in scripts/bounty-scanner.ts, Taken column on the board, 10 tests.
items.proof: the next board lists only funded issues with a Taken column and files only free ones

items.title: Claim ledger: a table in RESEARCH.md of every bounty attempted (issue, amount, PR, opened, merged, paid) kept by the build routine, and a weekly line in the report
items.why: The line's §4 numbers (claims, merges, payouts) have nowhere to live; without them the review cannot apply the kill rule. Built 2026-10-11 (burn-down): `## Claims` table in RESEARCH.md seeded with the three 10-11 reads, scripts/bounty-claims.ts (`npm run claims`, in `npm run check`) validates it and prints totals, kill-rule count and the week line; build, burn-down, weekly-report and review prompts updated; STRATEGY §4 row.
items.proof: the table exists and the weekly report reads it

items.title: Bounty scanner: drop issues whose reward is not code with tests on the project (user-testing sessions, showcase or community rewards, real-device recordings, maintainer-assigned claims) before they reach the queue
items.why: Six items filed in two boards (10-11, 10-12), six dropped by hand after a read: tt-metal needed hardware, turso was unfunded, quiver was a report, useagent#61 needs maintainer assignment and real-device recordings, useagent#113 pays for hand-run recorded sessions, Salam#1713 is a community reward for a showcase repo. Each read costs a build slot that could build a gankdat item. The scanner reads the issue body already; signals to drop or demote: "community reward", "build something with", "screen recording"/"recording of", "real device"/"real iPhone", "maintainer must assign"/"maintainer picks", "no scripts or other AIs", "per task"; keep only labelled or /bounty-funded feature or bug-fix work. Also write the reason into the BOARD table so the drop is visible without a read. Built 2026-10-12 (build): SHAPE_RULES + shapeExcluded in scripts/bounty-scanner.ts, applied through issueExcluded on title and body at the first pass; 3 tests on the three issues' real wording; board header and SCHEDULERS row say so.
items.proof: the next three boards file no item that a read then drops for shape; first-bounty-pr unblocks on a real code item
